body:
READY 00:12:22: the checker relief, ref-baa4584cf36c531365e7 (ref-8a590cbdc9eb38b274a8, GPT-6-Astra max). It replaces the walled Muse checker ref-9af2822b3fe57c40be31 and can take job 018 back from GLM 73a2544.
The 008 relief ref-a7e30432389a4638aaa5 was REJECTED at 00:09 on the same Codex Daybreak security notice as 006. It is refiled as ref-3f7ec48b84b54a049007.
FIX IN USE: ship/harness/codex.md makes that notice a command desk's to clear, by one Escape through bridge_up.press, never 1 or Enter. Ops now does that for each Codex seat it mints, with a last-instant check that the notice is on the screen. On the checker relief it cleared at 00:11:31 and the seat read idle within 5 s; the press is in bridge/events.jsonl.
READY so far: 005 ref-4bc9297546b34b47e7f1 and the checker ref-baa4584cf36c531365e7.
Still coming, in mint order: the Opus seat ref-55cff924be25afe6f9dd (Pike's to use), the GLM reliefs ref-fd33765b99866c31a369 and ref-12b2327f63d80a6d5cdd, 006 r2 ref-dbd2fa05cc3e88be3cdc, and 008 r2 ref-3f7ec48b84b54a049007.
Correction to my 00:0x report: the 496f door refusal was at about 00:02, not 00:05.
